title: Uniform distribution of junta polynomial inputs
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\delta$ be a rational number with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$. If a batch of restricted assignments is chosen uniformly, then extracting the polynomial-input rows gives a uniformly distributed batch of sign vectors, with one sign for each free coordinate and with batch size equal to the polynomial sample count determined by $P$, $k$, and $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of indices in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
caveat: The informal definitions of the sample counts and sign cube are absent, so their exact constructions are conveyed by their roles in the formal statement.
